$ qm attach new-item --session s-pane
exit 0
--- stdout
detached from 'old-item'
--- stderr
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst mm/mm new-item/new-item other-item/other-item src/src x-item/x-item

$ qm attach third --session s-two
exit 0
--- stdout
detached from 'other-item'
--- stderr
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third x-item/x-item

$ qm attach dst --session s-src
exit 0
--- stdout
detached from 'src'
--- stderr
qm: src's chat pane stays named src: dst already has a chat running
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third x-item/x-item

$ qm attach elsewhere --session s-aside
exit 0
--- stdout
detached from 'asd'
--- stderr
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third x-item/x-item

$ qm attach mm-target --session s-mm
exit 0
--- stdout
detached from 'mm'
--- stderr
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third x-item/x-item

$ qm attach new-item --session ghost
exit 0
--- stdout
--- stderr
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third x-item/x-item

$ qm attach new-item --session s-pane
exit 0
--- stdout
--- stderr
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third x-item/x-item

$ qm new Fresh --session s-new
exit 0
--- stdout
detached from 'x-item'
fresh
--- stderr
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst fresh/fresh mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third

$ qm new Fresh again --session never-seen --project demo
exit 0
--- stdout
fresh-again
--- stderr
tmux: a1/a1 a2/a2 asd/asd dst/dst fresh/fresh mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third

$ qm attach a3 --session s-multi
exit 0
--- stdout
detached from 'a1'
detached from 'a2'
--- stderr
tmux: a2/a2 a3/a3 asd/asd dst/dst fresh/fresh mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third

$ qm attach
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: qm attach SLUG --session SESSION_ID
tmux: a2/a2 a3/a3 asd/asd dst/dst fresh/fresh mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third

$ qm attach a3
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
usage: qm attach SLUG --session SESSION_ID
tmux: a2/a2 a3/a3 asd/asd dst/dst fresh/fresh mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third

$ qm attach ghost --session s
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
qm: no work item 'ghost'
tmux: a2/a2 a3/a3 asd/asd dst/dst fresh/fresh mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third

$ qm detach a3 --session s-multi
exit 0
--- stdout
--- stderr
tmux: a2/a2 a3/a3 asd/asd dst/dst fresh/fresh mm/mm new-item/new-item src/src third/third

=== old-item: sessions: []
=== new-item: sessions: | - id: s-pane | - id: ghost
=== src: sessions: []
=== dst: sessions: | - id: s-src
=== a1: sessions: []
=== a2: sessions: []
=== a3: sessions: []
=== fresh: sessions: | - id: s-new
=== fresh-again: sessions: | - id: never-seen
